message.content: On September 16, 2026, WolfgangSchulz proposes incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. He believes that this approach could significantly enhance their jazz fusion skills, making the practice sessions more fun, creative, and challenging. LiHua agrees enthusiastically, suggesting that improvisation will indeed make their sessions more enjoyable and creative. They discuss the possibility of picking a specific song to improvise over or just going with the flow, emphasizing the importance of spontaneity and having fun during the sessions.
